title: Extend the capability. Keep the simplicity.
summary: Add Markdown export through the existing dispatch path. One owner for validation, one error contract, and no parallel pipeline.

panels.title: One path, a useful extension point
A small change with a clear home
Why this design fits
panels.text: Extend the registry already used by the system. Keep validation, streaming, and errors in the existing path. A new framework would add complexity without solving a current problem.
